en.headline: Police hunt male staff member after HK$1.88 million camera theft at Times Square Fortress
en.dek: Sixty-one cameras and 55 lenses went missing from the Causeway Bay electronics store; officers are seeking a man aged about 40 who works there.
body: Police are searching for a male employee after photographic equipment valued at about HK$1.88 million disappeared from the Fortress store in Times Square, Causeway Bay.

The person in charge of the shop reported the loss to police shortly before 7pm on Thursday. Staff later found that 61 cameras and 55 camera lenses were missing. Officers classified the case as theft and assigned it to District Investigation Team 7 of Wan Chai Police District.

According to sources familiar with the inquiry, the man being sought is aged about 40 and is a staff member at the branch. No one has been arrested so far. Police have not released further details of the investigation.

zh.headline: 時代廣場豐澤失188萬元相機鏡頭 警追緝約40歲男職員
zh.dek: 銅鑼灣電器店有61部相機及55個鏡頭不翼而飛，警方正追緝一名年約40歲的店舖職員。
body: 警方正追緝一名男職員，事緣銅鑼灣時代廣場豐澤電器店有總值約188萬元的攝影器材失蹤。
周四晚上接近7時，店舖負責人向警方報案。職員其後發現61部相機及55個相機鏡頭不見。警方將案件列作盜竊，交由灣仔警區刑事調查隊第七隊跟進。
消息人士指，被追緝的男子年約40歲，為該分店職員。目前暫未有人被捕。警方未有公布更多調查詳情。
